title: introduce invocation cohort profiles and cohort-aware cost insights
author: Priya Nair
release_notes: Adds cohort profiling, cohort rollups, cost attribution heuristics, cost-weighted reservoir sampling, Grafana Cost Insights panels, and a synthetic-replay validator. Feature gated; no public API breaking changes.
description:
Motivation: Reduce alert noise and provide actionable cost/latency signals by grouping similar invocations into cohorts. This PR implements a cohort identifier in the invocation envelope, a cohort-rollup pipeline sharded by tenant, a marginal per-token cost attribution heuristic to explain spikes, a cost-weighted reservoir sampler to prioritize high-impact traces, and Grafana dashboards with cohort drilldowns and an alert-tuning helper. The feature is gated behind a feature flag and rolled out gradually.

High-level changes: telemetry schema additions for cohort fields, ingestion enrichment to compute cohort labels, new rollup worker computing per-cohort histograms and quantiles, marginal cost attributor with configurable decay, sampler implementation and benchmarks, Grafana panels under Observability > Cost Insights, a synthetic-replay validator for tuning alerts, and updated observability runbook.

Backward compatibility: The schema additions are optional; older consumers continue to function. Rollups are additive and do not change existing dashboards unless explicitly enabled. SDKs were extended with optional helpers to emit prompt fingerprints; defaults preserve prior behavior.

CI and review notes: Initial CI failed linting on import ordering; fixed in follow-up commit. Reviewers requested prompt-signature throttling to avoid cardinality explosion and feature-flag gating for sampler knobs; both addressed. Additional tests added for KV-miss heavy cases and sampler throughput.

Rollout plan: Gate OFF by default, enable ingestion for 10% of traffic, validate cardinality and rollup lag for 48h, enable rollups in staging and run synthetic-replay against 7 days of history, then ramp to 100% and apply cohort-aware alert tuning.

Operational impact: Estimated additional S3 storage ~12GB/day for rollups and ~2 CPU cores per shard. Sampler increases ingestion CPU by ~1% while reducing trace storage by targeted retention. Runbook includes metrics to watch and rollback steps if rollup lag exceeds thresholds.

Follow-ups: automatic cohort suggestion, integrate rollups with cost-explainer, tenant-aware budget alerts.
